book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso fɛ muh wù kibo kwe wa
Jiso ka wu gɛɛŋ wu lee yeh yi buunɛ le. Muh mu nyu yu a kibo ke kwe wa.
Bamii bamu ba gɛ̀ bee yu bo goone fiɛɛ fì bo kooyi yi Jiso le, bo mo bo noŋ ajii ye ye le bo tu bo jiiŋe laa wu lé wu fɛ̂ muh juu chi yuuŋ la.
Jiso jɛmɛ muh wu kibo ke gɛ̀ kwe wɛɛ le lɛ,
No wu to, Jiso biih bamii le lɛ,

content.text: “Fiɛɛ fì nchi le wu bɛɛŋ lɛ muh ge juu chi yuuŋ le fì la? Ki ba ge fiɛɛ fì joŋe, noo fì befe le? Ki ba fi muh noo, ki ba yuuyɛ lo le?”

content: Bo chii.
Jiso bijɛ bo bachii wu kɛnɛ bɛ shɛ́ŋ yì toonyɛ, shɛ́ŋ kwe wu, nje muntele muboo mù yiide. Wu jɛmɛ muh wù kibo ke gɛ̀ kwe wɛɛ le lɛ,
Wu nɛjɛ, ki mo ki tɛ̂mɛ.
Bafalashii mo bo bu, bo gɛɛŋ bɛ ŋgoo yi bamii ba Nfoŋ Hɛlod bo mo bo chu ntaŋ kimimia no bo lé bo gê fɛ bo yuuyɛ Jiso.
Bamii tu bo jade bimbe le bichii bo too fɛ Jiso le
Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo mo bo ja yo bo gɛɛŋ fɛ Mamasi wù Galalee le. Kinchvu ki bamii kì baaŋ bi wu le. Bamii bamu gɛ̀ ja kimbe kì Galalee bɛ kì Judia le.
Bamu ja Yɛlusalɛm, bamu kimbe kì Idumia le, bamu a Joo yì Jodaŋ le wuŋ kwege, bamu bimbe bi Taya bɛ Sidoŋ le. Kinchvu kiyu gɛ̀ too noo nje bo gɛ̀ yuge mwɛɛ mu wu gɛ̀ gee munchii.
Jiso ja wu jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ bo gooŋ ŋguh bo seesɛ bo gɛɛ wu lee yo, keefɛ kinchvu kiyu ja ki faase wu gɛ.
Wu gɛ̀ jɛme noo nje wu gɛ̀ fɛ wa bamii ba duude, bamii ba binchɛŋ wesee too bo kune wu le.
Sege bamii ba biyo bì yiide gɛ̀ njiiŋse bɛ bo gɛ̀ yɛŋ Jiso le bo mo bo gweeyi a wù fwe bo wanɛ bo duu lɛ, “Wo le Mwa Nyo.”
No bo gɛ̀ wanɛ noo, Jiso du lo bo le lɛ keefɛ bo gê bamii kɛ̂ɛ wu gɛ.
Jiso baa bamii yuufe ncho bafɛɛ lɛ le booŋ be ba ntuŋ
Wu ja wu bɛɛŋ wu gɛɛŋ yi mbegɛ le, wu tɛɛŋ bamii ba wu gɛ̀ goone bo to fɛ wu le.
Wu baa bamii yuufe ncho bafɛɛ, wu tɛɛŋ bo lɛ booŋ be ba ntuŋ,
lɛ bɛ bo nyume, wu tune bo, bo jiɛnyi bo feeji jɛ yi Nyo,
bo ka kɛme bvuŋga ki bo bvuuse banchɛndaa ba debele yi bamii le.
Bamii bayu gɛ̀ bee: Samoŋ, wu wù gɛ̀ nya jee che chimi lɛ Bita.
Jɛm bɛ mwa bwee wù Joŋ ba gɛ̀ bee booŋ ba Jɛbɛdi, ba wu gɛ̀ nya bo jee lɛ, “Boanɛgɛ” chì le lɛ, “Booŋ ba jaŋ yi mgbame.”
Bamu nyu Andulu, Filib, Batolomiu, Macho Toma, Jɛm wù mwa Alfayu, Tadio, Samoŋ wù gɛ̀ bee muh ŋgoo yi Bajalot,
mo Juda Ɛkaliot wù gɛ̀ kɛnɛ wu to wu gesɛ Jiso.
Bamii tu bo duu lɛ Bɛsebu wù nfoŋ banchɛndaa ba debele le yi Jiso le
Jiso ja wu gɛɛŋ fɛ wu gɛ̀ chee fo, kinchvu ki bamii ka kitaashɛ fo, bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ baaŋ kɛme gɛ lo je ki bo ji mwɛɛ gɛ.
Kfuu che gɛ̀ doo chi yu, bo mo bo gɛɛŋ ki bo jo wu nje bamii gɛ̀ duu lɛ wu ghaane lo.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo ba gɛ̀ ja Yɛlusalɛm bo boh yo bo tu bo duu lɛ, “Bɛsebu le ye ye le, wu bvuuse banchɛndaa ba debele banɛ, nyu bɛ bvuŋga bvu Nfoŋ wu banchɛndaa bayu.”
Jiso bɛɛŋ bo, wu biih bo le a ŋgaŋ le lɛ,

content.text: “Taŋlo Sataŋ ka wu bvuuse kikwɛɛ ke yi muh le nɛɛ?
Nɛ kituŋ ja ki gade ki juu lɛkilɛki, ki gɛ ka ki lɛɛŋ gɛ.
Yeh ja yi gade yi juu lɛyilɛyi, yi gɛ ka yi lɛɛŋ gɛ.
Noo, Sataŋ ja wu gade bɛ ŋgoo ye bo juu lɛbolɛbo, wu gɛ ka wu lɛɛŋ gɛ, mo nyu kimɛsɛ ke.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ gɛ muh nyu yu wu taŋlo wu lee yeh yi muh wu bvuŋga le, wu kudɛ mwɛɛ mwe yi nchiɛɛŋ le wu legɛ bɛ mu, njɛ wu ya wu kaaŋ muh bvuŋga wuyu fɛ wu kudɛ sɛŋ gɛ.
Nsɛɛŋ bɛŋ le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ Nyo taŋlo wu lɛɛshɛ mwɛɛ mù mbefe mo jɛ́ yì befe yichii yì bamii jɛme.
Geenɛ, muh wù jɛme jɛ yì befe kune Kiyo ki Yuude, tu gɛ taŋlo Nyo lɛɛshɛ gɛ, nje wu le wu ge kimbefɛ ki kage gɛ.”

content: Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme noo nje bamii bayu gɛ̀ duu lɛ kiyo kì yiide le yi ye ye le.
Bwe Jiso bɛ booŋ ba bwee Jiso
Bwe Jiso bɛ booŋ ba bwee Jiso mo bo fɛsɛ, bo lɛɛŋ akfuuŋ, bo tuŋ muh lɛ wu tɛɛŋ wu.
Gɛ̀ bee kinchvu ki bamii shii ki tuŋ kigaŋ bo taashɛ. Bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Bwoo bɛ booŋ ba bwoo goone wo akfuuŋ.”
Jiso biih lɛ,

content.text: “Bwaaŋ bɛ booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ le baaŋ?”

content: No wu bile noo wu mo wu jiŋɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ shilɛ bo tuŋ kigaŋ baa, wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bwaaŋ bɛ booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ le banɛ.
Muh wuchii wù gee fiɛɛ fì Nyo goone, le wu wu le mwa bwɛɛŋ bɛ jɛme yaŋ mo bwɛɛŋ.”

footnotes.text: Gɛ baŋwa ba kege bamu kɛme njɛme wu le lɛ, “Wu tɛɛŋ bo lɛ booŋ be ba tuŋ lɛ gɛ.”
Baŋwa ba kege bamu le ba taa fo fɛnɛ lɛ, “fɛde tɛ bamii ba binchɛŋ.”
Salot gɛ̀ bee Bajuu ba gɛ̀ toone woŋ, bo juu ki bo bvusɛ bo yi ŋgɛ le chiaaŋ yi bamii ba Lum le.
Bamii ba duude yɛde lɛ mwɛɛ mù mbefe mo jɛ́ yi befe chinɛ ba jɛme kune Nyo
